items.title: NFL free agency grades: Sizing up 55-plus big signings and trades
items.description: We're handing out report cards on big moves, including the Javon Hargrave signing and Osa Odighizuwa trade.

items.title: Sources: Byard, NFL's INTs leader in '25, to Pats
items.description: Free agent safety Kevin Byard III has agreed to sign with the Patriots on a one-year, $9 million deal, according to NFL Network.

items.title: Colts, QB Jones agree to 2-year, $88M contract
items.description: The Colts and quarterback Daniel Jones reached agreement Wednesday on a two-year, $88 million contract that can be worth up to $100 million, his agents told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

items.title: Sources: Ravens pivot, agree to add Hendrickson
items.description: The Ravens have agreed to sign Trey Hendrickson, sources told ESPN, in a high-priced pivot after their canceled blockbuster trade for Maxx Crosby.

items.title: Giants surprise, re-sign Neal despite struggles
items.description: The Giants re-signed first-round pick Evan Neal on Wednesday despite four disappointing years, which included him being a healthy scratch for most of this past season.

items.title: Source: Bucs add Mayfield backup in QB Browning
items.description: Free agent quarterback Jake Browning plans to sign a one-year deal with the Buccaneers, a source told ESPN's Jeremy Fowler.

items.title: Commanders adding TE Okonkwo, safety Cross
items.description: The Commanders have agreed to terms on a three-year contract with tight end Chig Okonkwo, agents Jason Chayut and Jared Fox told NFL Network.

items.title: Source: Jets add O-line reinforcement in Parham
items.description: The Jets have agreed to a two-year contract worth up to $20 million with guard Dylan Parham, according to NFL Network.

items.title: Vikings keep RB Jones on restructured $5.6M deal
items.description: Veteran running back Aaron Jones Sr. has restructured his deal with the Minnesota Vikings and won't be released, agent Drew Rosenhaus told ESPN.

items.title: Crosby commits after nixed trade: I'm a Raider
items.description: Maxx Crosby made his first public comments since the Ravens backed out of a trade that would've sent him to Baltimore, writing on X on Wednesday night, "Im a Raider. I'm back."

items.title: Ravens GM 'gutted' that Crosby deal fell through
items.description: Ravens GM Eric DeCosta got emotional at times in explaining it was a difficult but necessary decision to rescind the trade with the Raiders for Maxx Crosby, saying, "Nobody's more upset about this than me."

items.title: Cowboys trade DT Odighizuwa to 49ers for pick
items.description: The Cowboys traded defensive tackle Osa Odighizuwa to the 49ers in exchange for a 2026 third-round draft pick, and defensive tackle Solomon Thomas to the Titans in a seventh-round pick swap.

items.title: Ex-Fins OLB Chubb gets 3-year deal with Bills
items.description: Pass rusher Bradley Chubb reached agreement on a three-year, $43.5 million deal worth up to $52.5 million that includes $29 million guaranteed with the Bills, agent Erik Burkhardt told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

items.title: Court filing: Jackson feared Pearce 'will kill me'
items.description: WNBA player Rickea Jackson filed a petition for protection against her ex-boyfriend, Falcons player James Pearce Jr., saying she was "in fear of my life" and, if the court didn't intervene, she believed "James will kill me," according to court documents.

items.title: DT Hargrave stays in NFC North, joins Packers
items.description: Defensive tackle Javon Hargrave reached agreement Wednesday on a two-year, $23 million contract with the Packers, agent Drew Rosenhaus told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

items.title: Source: Browns cutting OT Conklin after 6 years
items.description: The Browns are releasing Jack Conklin, a starting offensive tackle whose six seasons in Cleveland were marred by injury, a source told ESPN.
